title: FileNode Serialize Wire mirror silently drops newly added fields
description: crate-jmap-filenode-types/src/filenode.rs:282-354. The hand-written Serialize builds Wire from self.field accesses. FileNode is #[non_exhaustive] and will gain fields (e.g. JMAP-0x31 spaceId); a new field not added to Wire still compiles and silently vanishes from the wire. Rewrite: start serialize() with an exhaustive destructure, let FileNode { id, parent_id, node_type, blob_id, target, size, name, media_type, created, modified, accessed, changed, executable, is_subscribed, my_rights, share_with, role, extra } = self; (no ..), then build Wire from the bindings. Adding a field then fails to compile until Wire handles it. Zero runtime cost, same line count.
close_reason: fixed in working tree (uncommitted), verified by adversarial reviewer + cargo test
